title: Strategies for Optimizing a Mailed FIT Program in Appalachia
official: Strategies for Optimizing a Mailed FIT Program in Appalachia
summary: The proposed study is examining strategies for optimizing mailed fecal immunochemical test (FIT) programs. In doing so, it will assess the efficacy of two promising strategies, FIT kit materials and patient navigation delivery mode. These strategies may help to improve colorectal cancer screening rates.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Resident of an Appalachian county
* Medical visit at a participating health system in the past two years
* Average-risk for colorectal cancer
* Not currently within colorectal cancer screening guidelines

Exclusion Criteria:
